policy: Continuation of V14.0 after R29; QUALITY-FIRST/ART-FIRST/DCC-FIRST/INTEGRATED VERTICAL SLICE. No official game or production change.

criticalArtReview.method: Direct visual comparison of four common matching original-game screenshots from R29 and R30, plus a single R30 65.25s full frame, not a Blender concept render or AI-generated image. Screenshots from original Chromium 1365x930 using source camera.
positiveChanges: R29's sharp jagged near-right polygon peaks became smoothly shaded continuous rock with actual real Blender Subsurf.
New scene has a genuinely evaluated boolean-excavated volume and nonplanar descending water mesh (technical method improvement).
Real road, player and top warning HUD remain visible in five scripted frames; this is not a verified fairness or fun assessment.
failures: 65.25 and 65.60: enormous pale sandstone-like cliff occupies the near left frame, reproducing R27's major scene-composition error with smoother geometry.
66.35 and 67.20: massive dark wall left and pale rock mass right narrowly frame the original road; scale and perspective feel like coarse disconnected shells rather than navigable carved harbor.
68.05: smooth beige right foreground and very dark left cliff still flank the race; original turbine appears as a separate functional object not visually founded in rock/industrial infrastructure.
Water remains a mostly uniform turquoise flat strip with no legible 23m waterfall or upper-lower basin transition at full driving camera speed.
Boolean cave is not recognizable as a convincing excavated aperture in these source-camera views. The distinctive working port, integrated quay and industrial operations remain missing.
40k triangles and true DCC modifiers did not produce a professional coherent art identity; metrics and green CI cannot substitute ART judgment.
criticalArtReview.continuedMethodRisk: Formula-driven large continuous 3D landforms created real geometry but remained too dominant in original chase camera; increasing smoothing and polycount is not an art solution.
criticalArtReview.scopeLimit: Qualitative screen review, no human tester, SAT, CCD, full-seven tick camera validation or Windows FPS certification.

restoration: No active source modification; all R30 authoring was in the isolated runner copy and R12A protected author and Game Git blob remained identical. No rollback needed.
nextEssentialDirection: Do not green-rerun or bulk-scale this rejected R30 model. Before any further substantive new candidate, make original camera screenshot a fixed foreground/midground/background silhouette contract: protect road/HUD/air; remove large enclosing terrain; purposefully author a small number of site-specific industrial masses grounded in original 34/12/42 with actual visible carved inlet/outlet. Use direct geometric art manipulation and source-camera feedback, not procedural repetition. Keep formal adoption and release on hold.
